name: Top Vendor Selling
query:
SELECT 
    pi.item_code AS "Item Code", 
    i.item_name AS "Item Name", 
    pr.supplier AS "Supplier",
    pi.warehouse AS "Warehouse", 
    SUM(pi.qty) AS "Received Quantity", 
    pr.posting_date AS "Posting Date"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pi
JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON pi.item_code = i.item_code
JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pi.parent = pr.name
GROUP BY 
    pr.supplier, pi.item_code, pi.warehouse, pr.posting_date
ORDER BY 
    SUM(pi.qty) DESC
LIMIT 5
